name: Prometheus
summary: Prometheus is an industrial-AI company co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, pursuing an artificial general engineer for physical-world industries.
overview: Prometheus is developing industrial AI systems for scientific and engineering applications.

facts.label: Latest financing
facts.note: Announced June 2026 at a $41B post-money valuation.

bull_case: A credible general-purpose engineering system could command extraordinary value across design, science, manufacturing, and energy.
bear_case: The valuation arrived before broad product disclosure, leaving technical progress and commercial demand largely unproven.
directory_notes: 150 employees across San Francisco, London, and Zurich, per reporting.
Industrial AI, compute intensity, and product disclosure.

intelligence.description: Prometheus is a secretive industrial-AI company pursuing what it calls an artificial general engineer. The central issue is whether an AI system can create defensible value in high-consequence scientific and engineering work rather than merely assist with it.
company: Prometheus emerged from stealth in 2026 with unusual scale for a company that has disclosed little about its product. It was co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj, a former Google executive and Verily co-founder, and is aimed at applying frontier AI to the physical world.

The company describes its goal as an artificial general engineer. That framing places it between foundation-model research, engineering software, industrial automation, and scientific discovery, but its product, revenue, and customer base remain largely undisclosed.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Prometheus is a concentrated bet on the claim that advanced AI will move from language and knowledge work into engineering and industrial systems. The financing is also a sharp signal of how much private capital is willing to underwrite frontier AI before a commercial product is visible.

changed.text: Raised a reported $6.2B Series A while operating quietly.
Emerging from stealth, Prometheus announced a $12B Series B at a $41B valuation.

takeaways: Prometheus has raised exceptional capital before making detailed public product claims.
Its thesis is more specific than a general chatbot: AI for the physical and engineered world.
Bezos and Bajaj give it unusual technical, commercial, and fundraising credibility.
The absence of disclosed customers, revenue, and benchmarks makes the valuation unusually dependent on future execution.
